stories.headline: datasette-llm 0.1a11 adds OpenAI‑compatible endpoint support
stories.what_happened: The datasette-llm plugin for Datasette was updated to version 0.1a11. The update introduces support for OpenAI‑compatible endpoints, allowing Datasette to connect to any LLM that implements the OpenAI pseudo‑standard web protocol, including locally hosted models via LM Studio, Ollama, or llama.cpp.
stories.why_it_matters: Developers can now integrate a wider range of LLM services, including self‑hosted models, into Datasette workflows without relying on proprietary APIs, expanding flexibility and reducing dependency on external providers.

stories.headline: Legal petition seeks warrant requirement for ALPR data searches

sources.title: We're Asking an Appeals Court to Require a Warrant for ALPR Searches

stories.what_happened: A petition has been filed with a federal appeals court requesting that law‑enforcement agencies obtain a warrant before searching data collected by Automated License Plate Readers (ALPR).
stories.why_it_matters: If granted, the ruling would limit warrantless access to large‑scale vehicle location data, strengthening privacy protections and potentially changing how agencies store, share, and query ALPR databases.
